quest.title: The Foolish Fatuus
quest.description: There are several strange camps in the Sumeru forest, and each camp has a strange machine installed within. The Fatui seem to be using these machines to do something weird. It's best to investigate this matter...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x400, Primogem x50, Mora x40000, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

dialogues.speaker: Rukh Shah
dialogues.text: I must thank you both.

dialogues.speaker: Rukh Shah
dialogues.text: And let me know if you have any clues about Kasim's whereabouts.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Shhh, {NICKNAME}, look over there! An Eremite member and... a Fatuus!
Kasim... how are these Saghira Machines working?

dialogues.speaker: Kasim
dialogues.text: Working good, Oleg...

dialogues.speaker: Kasim
dialogues.text: This is the result report. And if nothing goes wrong, it won't take long for you to get what you want...

dialogues.speaker: Oleg
dialogues.text: Hahaha, great! With your help, we will be able to complete the order of our Lord Harbingers in no time.

dialogues.speaker: Oleg
dialogues.text: But if you dare lie to me... you will pay the price!

dialogues.speaker: Kasim
dialogues.text: What's in it for me to lie to you?

dialogues.speaker: Oleg
dialogues.text: Anyway, you know what I mean.

dialogues.speaker: Oleg
dialogues.text: Hmph, Trofin Snezhevich... That guy didn't achieve anything here in the past few years, whereas I have already gotten results. Well, won't we see what he has to say for himself then?

dialogues.speaker: Kasim
dialogues.text: Trofin Snezhevich... I've never heard that name in Sumeru...

dialogues.speaker: Oleg
dialogues.text: Haha, of course you haven't. Surely he wouldn't use this name to reveal himself... The Lord Harbinger sent him here, but he's made no progress all these years.

dialogues.speaker: Oleg
dialogues.text: ...Wait, wh—who is there? How did you get in here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Oops, {NICKNAME}, they found us!

dialogues.speaker: Kasim
dialogues.text: ...I should leave now.

dialogues.speaker: Kasim
dialogues.text: Hm, Fatuus, you won't lose to some random adventurer who broke in, will you?

dialogues.speaker: Oleg
dialogues.text: None of your business, Eremite guy. I'll beat down this rude intruder and head to the research camp we talked about.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Kasim leaves...

dialogues.speaker: Oleg
dialogues.text: If I weren't exhausted by retaking the camp... Ugh, I'll get you next time!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Oleg runs away amidst the chaos...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, that's a quick getaway...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, the thing he left behind is... an "Emergency Adjustment Plan"?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's see what it says...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Since the Saghira Machine operation is an important link in Snezhnaya's research projects in Sumeru, there is no room for failure... Recently our research camps have suffered from repeated breaches of security, resulting in the breakdown of the machines..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, someone broke through their camps multiple times. That's impressive. Paimon wonders who those kind and brave people are!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, yeah. Then, "we need to retake the camp. Patrols will be stepped up today... Make your rounds <color=#00E1FFFF>in the order of the camps marked on this map...</color>"

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: As you can see in this picture, the camp we are in is the starting point for the patrol.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So they need to recapture these four camps! Interesting that the Fatui would seek help from the Eremites...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... And it goes "...set out from the action stronghold and execute the above plan." So they even have an operation stronghold...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph, if only we knew where this operation stronghold is...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Let's wipe them all out!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh-huh! Now let's head to the camps in order. We'll definitely catch the Fatui!

dialogues.speaker: Oleg
dialogues.text: Argh, lost again...

dialogues.speaker: Oleg
dialogues.text: I bet you are one of those who'd do anything for Mora, right?

dialogues.speaker: Oleg
dialogues.text: How about this? I give you Mora, and you get out of the way, you in?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Whoa, {NICKNAME}, this Fatui guy does know us well!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But listen, we'll take the Mora...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But we won't stay away!

dialogues.speaker: Oleg
dialogues.text: Ugh, why are you so annoying? That's some beef between us, just you wait!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Oleg runs away amidst the chaos...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, Paimon couldn't even see his moves... it's like one blink, and he's gone!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This Fatuus is actually skilled in running away!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: One... Two... Next up is camp number three on the patrol route. We aren't gonna run into him there, right...

dialogues.speaker: Oleg
dialogues.text: Geez, what are you after?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: To stop you from doing bad things, of course!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell us what the machines are used for!

dialogues.speaker: Oleg
dialogues.text: ...Hmph, no way. You must be daydreaming!

dialogues.speaker: Oleg
dialogues.text: Ugh, I've fought too much today... Gotta get some rest at the stronghold...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Oleg runs away amidst the chaos...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, how does he manage to escape every time? Just why...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon guesses he had no idea that we had his plan, though. Just look at his surprised face...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He said he was going back to base to rest. In other words, he won't be patrolling the last camp on the map...

choices.text: But according to the Emergency Adjustment Plan...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yes, you're right. We can't leave the weird suction fans activated like that...

choices.text: Let's just take it as clearing out the Fatui!

talks.objective: Follow the path and go to the last camp

dialogues.speaker: Kasim
dialogues.text: Ouch... Geez, don't hit me... Stooop that!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you really some legendary bandit...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're much weaker than I imagined...

dialogues.speaker: Kasim
dialogues.text: Not every bandit is known for their physical strength...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hm, that's a slick tongue. We should really ask him some right questions!

dialogues.speaker: Kasim
dialogues.text: Go ahead. I promise I'll tell everything in my knowledge, hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you really a bandit from the Eremites?

dialogues.speaker: Kasim
dialogues.text: Yes, sure...

choices.text: The Eremites certainly aren't picky about who they recruit.

response.speaker: Kasim
response.text: We are the Eremites, after all. We're from different places and all walks of life, haha!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Speaking of this, how on earth did the Fatui find you?

response.speaker: Kasim
response.text: They came for my hard-earned reputation in the Eremites, of course...

choices.text: The Eremites are Sumeru locals after all...

response.speaker: Kasim
response.text: Some sages in the Akademiya are officially in cooperation with the Fatui, but the Fatui can't really reach Sumeru through the secret moves... And that's when I come to help!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: He's actually proud...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: In short, the Fatui turned to you for some strange experiment, telling you to set the suspicious suction fans in the camps...

response.speaker: Kasim
response.text: Ah, so you're asking about the Saghira Machines. The Fatui somehow wanted something for energy extraction from Withering Zones, so I provided some...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Machines for energy extraction from Withering Zones!?

response.speaker: Kasim
response.text: That's right. It took me quite some effort to dig them out of the ruins...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Seems that anything could appear in the Sumeru ruins...

response.speaker: Kasim
response.text: I have no idea whether the Withering Zones are really drained of energy or not. Anyway, the Fatui know nothing about it, and I would always make up some experiment results...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What's that? You're lying to the Fatui too!

response.speaker: Kasim
response.text: Well, hehe, isn't that good news to you...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's true though... Paimon doesn't know which is more evil between you and the Fatui.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Speaking of this, since you've been working with the Fatui for so long, Paimon bets you know where their stronghold is!

choices.text: You're lying again! Is your face itching or what?

response.speaker: Kasim
response.text: ...Alright, I'll tell you the truth. I actually bought the machines from a researcher named Abattouy. I forgot the details, but he called them some kind of extractor as well!

response.speaker: Kasim
response.text: So I just forged a new name, and branded them as something for energy extraction from the Withering Zones...

response.speaker: Kasim
response.text: After all, I just need something that appears convincing to the Fatui. The machines actually look legit right? Hehehe...

choices.text: Don't get cocky! Tell the truth!

response.speaker: Kasim
response.text: Ah... So actually, I was once away from Sumeru for a while, calling myself "Kasim the Sumeru Bandit" and getting into contact with the Fatui... Hehe...

response.speaker: Kasim
response.text: Then I returned, started recruitment funded by the Fatui, and became the real "Kasim the Bandit" here in the Eremites. But coins have two sides... I can't really reject any requests from the Fatui from then on...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So that's what happened...

choices.text: Then let's go and meet the Corps of Thirty...

response.speaker: Kasim
response.text: Oh, stop mentioning the Corps of Thirty, will you? We could always talk... Ugh, okay, "Kasim the Bandit" is just a stage name. You just need a title for swindling...

response.speaker: Kasim
response.text: That's how the Fatui bought my words this time...

dialogues.speaker: Kasim
dialogues.text: Ah, as things stand now, I might as well tell you everything... I've been providing fake experiment results, and they seem to be suspecting me...

dialogues.speaker: Kasim
dialogues.text: I'll reveal the location of the stronghold. Please catch them. This way, the Fatui would never know that I've been fabricating the results...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, he's really rotten to the core. The Fatui got into some serious trouble cooperating with him!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's just hear him out for now...

dialogues.speaker: Kasim
dialogues.text: Near the tents in the Apam Woods, there are four torches. Light them at night...

dialogues.speaker: Kasim
dialogues.text: And the Fatui will respond with signal lights. So if you see bright spots on nearby cliffs...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That means the Fatui operation stronghold lies right there! What an interesting communication method...

dialogues.speaker: Kasim
dialogues.text: Yes. The Fatui behind the gate will ask you for the watchword, and only those who get it right can enter...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They even set up a watchword!

dialogues.speaker: Kasim
dialogues.text: That's right. Let me see, the first half is "Never bring your own rule book..."

dialogues.speaker: Kasim
dialogues.text: And the second half is "to someone else's place."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, hope the Fatui could actually honor their watchword...

dialogues.speaker: Kasim
dialogues.text: Come on, let's try it out. "Never bring your own rule book..."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "To someone else's place."

dialogues.speaker: Kasim
dialogues.text: Great, go ahead! For the sake of not revealing my true identity to the Fatui, please catch them!

dialogues.speaker: Kasim
dialogues.text: Hehe, see... I've given you such important information. Perhaps you could, you know... let me off the hook...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph, behave yourself after this! If you're found doing any tricks again... we'll see you with the Corps of Thirty!

dialogues.speaker: Kasim
dialogues.text: Sure, with you two here in Sumeru, I won't do anything mischievous ever, ever again! So, just forgive me this time!

dialogues.speaker: Kasim
dialogues.text: Hehe, I'll get outta here then. Wish you success!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Kasim flees in a hurry...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um... Maybe we should send this guy to the Sheriff...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But we might as well deal with the Fatui first.

dialogues.speaker: Kasim
dialogues.text: Their stronghold... Ah, of course I know where it is... It's located in...

dialogues.speaker: Kasim
dialogues.text: ...Ah, can you see the mountains over there?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The mountains over there? You mean that's where the Fatui stronghold lies?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But Paimon doesn't see anything unusual there. Kasim... Huh? Where did he go?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He must've sneaked away!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wah, that's so despicable!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We were so close to the key information!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But Kasim was initially meeting with the Fatui here... Maybe we can find some clues around.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's check the camp first!

talks.objective: Search the camp for clues about the Fatui stronghold

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look here! It's a book named "A Guide to Clandestine Contact With the Fatui"... Paimon wonders if we can find clues regarding the Fatui operation stronghold here...

dialogues.speaker: "A Guide to Clandestine Contact With the Fatui"
dialogues.text: "At night, go near the tents in Apam Woods. Light four torches there..."

dialogues.speaker: "A Guide to Clandestine Contact With the Fatui"
dialogues.text: "Then, go towards the signal lights. The stronghold lies where the lights come from..." Wow, so this is how they've been communicating...

dialogues.speaker: "A Guide to Clandestine Contact With the Fatui"
dialogues.text: "Remember, the code is: Never bring your own rule book to someone else's place..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #They even have a code! {NICKNAME}, let's give it a try. "Never bring your own rule book..."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "To someone else's place."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They say "never bring your own rule book to someone else's place," but hmph! The Fatui brought this contact rule with them to Sumeru...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, let's go to Apam Woods and get those Fatui!

talks.objective: Go to the secret contact campsite
Talk to Oleg, who will check your watchword

dialogues.speaker: Oleg
dialogues.text: Eh? No way... Ahem, watchword, please. "Never bring your own rule book..."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "To someone else's place."

dialogues.speaker: Oleg
dialogues.text: Hmph, come in already, you... Hmph, you must be the newbies here for support. What took you so long?

dialogues.speaker: Oleg
dialogues.text: You have no idea how important this experiment is! You are not only late, but...

dialogues.speaker: Oleg
dialogues.text: Hmph, and you took over the camps, stopped the Saghira Machines, and interrupted our experiment!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uh-oh!

dialogues.speaker: Oleg
dialogues.text: Come on, I've been attacked... I've fought you three times... What made you think you could fool me with a mask...

dialogues.speaker: Oleg
dialogues.text: Do you know why I let you in even after I recognized you? Well, it's a trap!

dialogues.speaker: Oleg
dialogues.text: #Get {F#her}{M#him}! This is the brat that hampered our experiment!

dialogues.speaker: Oleg
dialogues.text: We were actually defeated... even with so many members...

dialogues.speaker: Oleg
dialogues.text: If only the experiments went well, I would...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nah, that's not gonna happen. The machine named San-something from Kasim won't extract anything from the Withering Zones...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's to say, he's been lying to you all this time!

dialogues.speaker: Oleg
dialogues.text: Just how!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You can repent all you want with the Corps of Thirty, and remember to stay away from Sumeru for the rest of your life!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You inform Parchamdar Rukh Shah from the Corps of Thirty.\nHe and his subordinates take the Fatui away.

dialogues.speaker: Rukh Shah
dialogues.text: Were it not for you, we'd never have known what suspicious things the camp has been used for... We will take away these Fatui.

dialogues.speaker: Rukh Shah
dialogues.text: According to researchers' investigation, even though no influence was exerted on the Withering Zones, the mere operation of the machines has somehow polluted the environment. If we failed to stop them in time...

dialogues.speaker: Rukh Shah
dialogues.text: The forest might be damaged.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I see...

dialogues.speaker: Rukh Shah
dialogues.text: Yes, the Corps of Thirty will take custody of these machines, and similar incidents should be prevented in the future...

dialogues.speaker: Rukh Shah
dialogues.text: But due to ownership issues, it may not be possible to bring all the camps under our direct management... I won't be too worried about it though.

dialogues.speaker: Rukh Shah
dialogues.text: Besides, the bounty on Kasim has been raised according to your report... That guy has always been a fraud that gives us headaches.

dialogues.speaker: Rukh Shah
dialogues.text: Even those Eremite mercenaries fell for his scam this time. He went behind the Corps of Thirty and contacted them directly, offering to share a huge payout for extracting energy from the Ley Lines...

dialogues.speaker: Rukh Shah
dialogues.text: Never mind. I'll teach him a lesson the next time I see him!

dialogues.speaker: Rukh Shah
dialogues.text: Here, take your rewards for turning in the Fatui! We caught them all thanks to you.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Rukh Shah leaves...
